data.name: ExitsHowToCheck
data.value: Not checked against your list yet. Screenshot the game's extract list (raid start, or O twice) to check.
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS in a raid, before the extract list was read. 'O twice' is the game's key for the extract list.

data.name: ExitsNoReader
data.value: Can't read your extract list: Windows has no text recognition language. Add one in Windows Settings → Time & language → Language.
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS, when Windows can't recognise text. Name Windows' own settings path as Windows shows it in this language.

data.name: ExitsListRead
data.value: Your list this raid: {listed} of {extracts, plural, one {# extract} other {# extracts}} (screenshot at {time}).
data.comment: Rail, under EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS, once the list was read. {listed}: extracts the list names; {extracts}: the side's extracts on this map; {time}: the screenshot's time, 16:40.

data.name: ExitsRowListed
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind ("PMC extract · on your list"), once the game's extract list was read and names it. Lower case, a fragment.

data.name: ExitsRowUnsure
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind, when the game's list names it with ??:??:?? (maybe closed, or it needs something first). "???" as the game shows it.

data.name: ExitsRowNotListed
data.comment: Rail, EXTRACTS AND TRANSITS: an extract's row, after its kind, when the game's extract list leaves it out.

data.name: ExitsGlanceListed
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT (the nearest extract): the game's extract list names it.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnsure
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT: the game's list names it with ??:??:?? (maybe closed, or it needs something first).

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnchecked
data.value: Nearest · not checked against your list
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT, before a screenshot showed the game's extract list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceNoReading
data.value: Nearest · check your list in game
data.comment: Raid card, under EXIT, when the list can't be read from screenshots (unticked in settings, or Windows can't recognise text).

data.name: ExitsGlanceListedTip
data.value: On the game's extract list for this raid, read from your screenshot.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card, for an extract on the game's list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUnsureTip
data.value: On your list, but the game shows ??:??:??: maybe closed, or needs something first.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card, for an extract the game's list shows with ??:??:??.

data.name: ExitsGlanceUncheckedTip
data.value: Nearest extract for your side, maybe not open this raid. Screenshot the game's extract list (raid start, or O twice) to check.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card before the extract list was read. 'O twice' is the game's key for the extract list.

data.name: ExitsGlanceNoReadingTip
data.value: Nearest extract for your side, maybe not open this raid. Check your list in the game.
data.comment: Tooltip of EXIT in the raid card when the list can't be read from screenshots.

data.name: ExitsPlainNote
data.comment: Raid card, the OR row under EXIT (shown in capitals): the nearest extract on the list that takes nothing to leave by.

data.name: ExitsPlainTip
data.value: The nearest extract on your list this raid that takes nothing: no item, money, flare, switch or second player.
data.comment: Tooltip of the OR row under EXIT in the raid card.

data.name: CompleteOne
data.comment: The QUEST COMPLETE cue's eyebrow, one quest handed in to a trader Shturmap can't name. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteOneFrom
data.comment: The QUEST COMPLETE cue's eyebrow, one quest handed in. {trader}: the trader's name in capitals, PRAPOR. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteSeveral
data.comment: The cue's eyebrow when several quests were handed in together. Capitals.

data.name: CompleteSeveralCount
data.comment: The cue's title when several quests were handed in together. {count}: how many, 2 or more.

data.name: CompleteUnlocks
data.comment: The cue's detail line: the quests the completed ones unlock. {quests}: their names as a list ("Setup and Shooter Born in Heaven"; ListLast, ListMore).

data.name: ListSeparator
data.comment: Between the names of a list of names, before its last one ("A, B and C"): the comma and the space after it.

data.name: ListLast
data.comment: A list of names, as the QUEST COMPLETE cue says them: "A, B and C". {list}: the names before the last, with ListSeparator between them; {last}: the last name.

data.name: ListMore
data.comment: A list of names cut short: "A, B, C and 2 more". {list}: the names shown, with ListSeparator between them; {count}: how many more there are.

data.name: AgeSeconds
data.comment: How old the last position is, under a minute: status bar ("Fix 12 s ago") and raid card. {seconds}: whole seconds.

data.name: AgeMinutes
data.comment: How old the last position is, under an hour: "Fix 4 min ago". {minutes}: whole minutes.

data.name: AgeHours
data.comment: How old the last position is, an hour or more: "Fix 2 h ago". {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: FixNoneYet
data.value: No position yet: press {keys} for distances
data.comment: Raid card, the line under the raid line, in a raid without a position. {keys}: the game's screenshot keys as help names them, "PrtSc or Home".

data.name: FixDistancesFrom
data.comment: Raid card, the line under the raid line, once the last position is no longer fresh. {age}: how old it is ("45 s", "9 min"; AgeSeconds, AgeMinutes, AgeHours).

data.name: RaidTimeTip
data.value: Time left: the map's raid length minus the time since the raid's start in the log. Can be off after a reconnect.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock (time in the raid and time left).

data.name: RaidTimeScavTip
data.value: Time since you joined, by the log. A Scav joins mid-raid, so the time left isn't known.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock in a Scav raid.

data.name: RaidTimeNoLengthTip
data.value: Time since the raid's start, by the log. No raid length for this map, so no time left.
data.comment: Tooltip of the raid card's clock on a map whose raid length tarkov.dev doesn't give.

data.name: RaidTimeScav
data.value: {gone} min in · time left not known
data.comment: The raid's time in words, a Scav raid. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started.

data.name: RaidTimeNoLength
data.comment: The raid's time in words, on a map without a raid length. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started.

data.name: RaidTimeLeft
data.comment: The raid's time in words. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started; {left}: whole minutes left.

data.name: RaidTimeOver
data.value: {gone} min in · past the raid's {length} min
data.comment: The raid's time in words, past the map's raid length. {gone}: whole minutes since the raid started; {length}: the map's raid length in minutes.

data.name: StatusNoPosition
data.comment: Status bar (shown in capitals), in a raid without a position. {keys}: the game's screenshot keys as help names them, "PrtSc or Home".

data.name: MapListOtherMaps
data.comment: The MAP list at the top of the rail: the heading over the maps none of your quests is on. Capitals.

data.name: TraderStripTip
data.value: {trader} · {count, plural, one {# active quest} other {# active quests}} · click to hold
data.comment: Tooltip of a trader's portrait in the strip under the MAP list. A click holds the trader's focus: the rows and the map step the other traders' quests back, the maps count the trader's quests. {trader}: the trader's name as the game data gives it ("Ragman"); {count}: that trader's active quests, 0 or more.

data.name: TraderStripTipHeld
data.value: {trader} · {count, plural, one {# active quest} other {# active quests}} · click to let go
data.comment: The same tooltip while that trader's focus is held (the portrait framed in amber): a click lets the focus go. {trader}, {count}: as in TraderStripTip.

data.name: PlanRowTrader
data.comment: A map's count in Plan's rows and in the MAP list while a trader's portrait is clicked (held): how many of that trader's active quests are on the map ("Ragman 2"), in place of "Complete 5 · progress 1". {trader}: the trader's name as the game data gives it; {count}: 1 or more. Keep it this short.

data.name: TourEyebrow
data.comment: The tour's band, above the chapter's title. {chapter}: the chapter shown, from 1; {count}: how many chapters. Capitals.

data.name: WhatsNewHeading
data.comment: The What's New card's heading over a version's lines. {version}: the version with its release's name, "0.4.0 · PRAETORIAN". Capitals.

data.name: OperationalAsOf
data.comment: The right part of the OPERATIONAL eyebrow on a map's card in Plan: when the daily and weekly tasks were read from a screenshot of the game's Tasks screen. {time}: "14:02". Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalAsOfDay
data.comment: As OperationalAsOf, when the tasks were read on an earlier day. {date}: "18 Oct"; {time}: "14:02". Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalCount
data.comment: An operational task's progress in its row's muted line: its objective's count as the screenshot showed it ("4 OF 7 · 8 H LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalPercent
data.comment: An operational task's progress in its row's muted line when it has no single count: the game's percentage ("57% · 8 H LEFT").

data.name: OperationalAnyMap
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan, first, for a task the game says counts on any location ("ANY MAP · HAND OVER AFTER · 2 D LEFT"; the raid card says ANYWHERE in its distance column instead). Shown in capitals; the ANY MAP heading's words.

data.name: OperationalHandOverAfter
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan, for items found in raid that are handed over to the trader after the raid ("ANY MAP · HAND OVER AFTER · 2 D LEFT"). Shown in capitals; short.

data.name: OperationalHandOverAfterRaid
data.comment: As OperationalHandOverAfter, in the raid card ("HAND OVER AFTER THE RAID", with ANYWHERE in the row's distance column). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalMinutesLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, under an hour ("4 OF 7 · 25 MIN LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalHoursLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, under two days, rounded down ("4 OF 7 · 8 H LEFT"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalDaysLeft
data.comment: An operational task's time left in its row's muted line in Plan, from two days on, rounded down (a weekly: "2 D LEFT"). {count}: the days. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadJustNow
data.comment: An operational task's muted line in Plan in place of its time left, when its countdown couldn't be read for sure: how old the screenshot is, under a minute. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadMinutesAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, under an hour ("READ 25 MIN AGO"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadHoursAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, under two days, rounded down ("READ 3 H AGO"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalReadDaysAgo
data.comment: As OperationalReadJustNow, from two days on, rounded down ("READ 3 D AGO"). {count}: the days. Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalEndsIn
data.comment: An operational task's time in the raid card, only when it ends before the raid could, in red ("4 OF 7 · ENDS IN 25 MIN"). Shown in capitals.

data.name: OperationalEnded
data.value: {count, plural, one {# ended at {time}. Screenshot your tasks for the new one.} other {# ended, the last at {time}. Screenshot your tasks for the new ones.}}
data.comment: Under the OPERATIONAL eyebrow, muted, when daily or weekly tasks ran out since the last screenshot of the game's Tasks screen: the game gives new ones, which only a new screenshot shows. {count}: how many ended; {time}: when the last did, "22:35".
